convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'AdaptiveRenko' custom indicator with 4 buffers, plus includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management. Both require manual Python reimplementation.

derived_values.name: Volatility basis for brick size
derived_values.formula: ATR(VltPeriod) or StDev(VltPeriod) depending on Indicator enum, multiplied by K

other_exits: Long position closed on down brick signal (DnVal[1] non-zero) when BuyPosClose=true
Short position closed on up brick signal (UpVal[1] non-zero) when SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM<0 uses fixed lot size equal to |MM|; MM>0 uses deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: AdaptiveRenko is a custom Renko charting indicator where brick size adapts based on ATR or StDev volatility. Entry logic: new up brick appears (buffer 2 non-zero on current bar, zero on previous) triggers buy; new down brick (buffer 3 non-zero on current bar, zero on previous) triggers sell. The signal is only evaluated on new bar arrival or on SignalBar=0 (every tick). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar helper functions - these must be reimplemented. The indicator uses 4 buffers total (buffers 0-3); only buffers 2 and 3 are read by this EA.
python_conversion_notes: Requires: (1) Full reimplementation of AdaptiveRenko indicator logic - Renko brick construction with adaptive brick size based on ATR or StDev, minimum brick width WideMin points, using either High/Low or Close price mode. (2) Reimplementation of TradeAlgorithms.mqh position management (open/close with SL/TP, deposit-fraction sizing, deviation checks). (3) New-bar detection logic. The adaptive Renko logic is non-trivial: must reconstruct the Renko chart from OHLC data where brick height = max(WideMin, K*ATR(VltPeriod)) or max(WideMin, K*StDev(VltPeriod)), then detect new brick appearances as trade signals. Entry signal is a NEW brick (current non-zero, previous zero in the signal buffer).
